Clipped

Video shot-list — reference videos by format (one per unique creator)

Who they are

Clipped (by Chrona) is a podcast app for people who listen to learn — word-for-word transcripts synced to audio, one-tap saving of the best highlights (or hand-picked from the transcript), and a daily review to actually retain what you hear. Tagline: 'Save the best of any podcast.'

The content plan

  • What's here: reference videos to film across 4 proven formats — each shows the top-performing creators doing a variant of that format.
  • Formats: 1) Bad / Good / Great · 2) List of X things to achieve Y goal · 3) Problem → solution (note-taking) · 4) Lists of top podcasts.
  • One per creator: each format shows one video per unique creator (every distinct creator who's winning the format — repeats trimmed).
  • How to use: click any thumbnail to watch; replicate the format for Clipped (save the best of any podcast / note-taking → retention).
